name: pull-requests
summary: Every fix or feature ends as a proven, reviewed draft pull request, and ship words take it to merged.
day: You ask for a fix, and later find a draft pull request with its tests, its proof, and a review from a second model.
cost: Needs GitHub, which setup signs in to. Each pull request costs one extra review run.
risk: Ship words merge without asking again. Say them only for work you would merge yourself.

settings.question: Which comments should agents show you before they post them?
Which command merges a pull request when the repo names none?
How many review rounds may run before the review arbiter decides whether another round is worth it?
After how many review rounds does review stop for good?
How many minutes may one review run before it counts as failed?
How many reviewers may run at once in a review panel?

workflows.name: Draft PR flow
workflows.sentence: Every fix or feature ends as a proven, reviewed draft pull request that you mark ready yourself.

moment.title: A draft pull request, already reviewed
moment.body: The fix you asked for at breakfast is a draft pull request: tests first, proof attached, and a second model's review answered.

workflows.name: PR care
workflows.sentence: Agents watch your pull requests, fix CI, answer review comments, and refresh stale pull requests.

moment.title: CI went red, and it is already fixed
moment.body: A check failed on your pull request over lunch. The agent watching it found the cause, pushed a fix, and answered the reviewer's comment.

workflows.name: Ship words
workflows.sentence: Say "full send" or "stamp it", and the agent takes a pull request to merged and rolled out.

moment.title: "full send"
moment.body: You read the draft, like it, and type two words. The agent marks it ready, waits for approval and green checks, merges, and watches the rollout.

workflows.risk: The agent merges without asking again once you say the words.
